title: Why strength training matters more after 50 — and how to start at home

posts.facebook:
Muscle drifts away from your thirties onward unless you push back. Two short sessions a week is the push.

A plain explanation of sarcopenia (age-related muscle loss), the six movements that cover the whole body, beginner sets and reps, bodyweight versus bands versus dumbbells, and how to progress safely at home.

Learn six movements, do them twice a week, and add a little each fortnight.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/move/strength-training-after-50-why-and-how/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
